desc: Derive and document the closed-form formula: C(n-1, k) * m * (m-1)^(n-1-k) modulo 1e9+7.
Implement countGoodArrays using the closed-form formula with efficient modular binomial computation and edge-case handling.
Implement a modular binomial coefficient helper for n up to 1e5, either with precomputed factorials and inverse factorials or an O(k) multiplicative method.
Verify edge cases, especially m=1, k=0, k=n-1, and n=1.
Test against the provided examples and add a few random small brute-force checks if needed.
